oracle.acceptance: Exact prompt IDs, generated IDs, complete decoded stream and stop reason against independent CPU reference; fail before performance on any mismatch.

performance.cacheScope: Fresh process with per-process empty driver/provider cache directories; identical explicit cache policy. OS file cache uncontrolled. Separate opening, initial generation, resident generation and settled teardown. No acquisition claim.
performance.failurePolicy: No outcome-selected retry or promotion; retain all failures and unfavorable cohorts.
performance.timingAdmission: Require exact independent output/stopping and cancellation/reuse/settlement qualification, physical shader correctness, reserved AMD access, then independent-process identical-byte A/A stability for every case before attribution or candidate timing.

scope: New complete-generation campaign; historical contracts and rejected candidates unchanged. Frozen candidate-doppler.tgz SHA256 308ebeeb19ee235c6de3d49aa5738aefa72aa742ce3bbf7e7f96530cb74b189b includes the retained sampled-logits ownership correction, against the recorded package source lineage. Requalify all three new cases independently. W8A8 excluded. Starting Doe commit is provenance only: baseline must bind corrected source and new library bytes before any physical execution. Doppler source field identifies the package base; the retained ownership.patch.gz and exact archive identify the two-file correction, not an unmodified checkout.

latencyCampaign.primaryMetric: complete-generation latency: equal-weight geometric mean of per-case resident process medians
latencyCampaign.aggregation: One process is one independent block. Linear-interpolated p50/p95; bootstrap independent process blocks, never tokens. Both 95% confidence limits of each A/A complete-generation ratio must lie within [1/1.05,1.05]. Both comparisons require the aggregate lower confidence bound to reach their gain threshold. Each case initial/resident latency, first token, and p95 must obey the 1.05 regression bound against each control.
latencyCampaign.memory: Measure process high-water RSS, logical requested allocation bytes, retained pool capacity, and observed DRM memory separately. Maximum RSS and requested/retained capacity ratios 1.05; unchanged 1073741824-byte requested-buffer budget. Observed DRM residency is diagnostic, not exclusive physical GPU RAM.
latencyCampaign.stoppingRule: Fixed eight independent processes per label/provider, one warmup and two resident requests per case per process. No optional stopping or outcome-selected retry. Retain failed invocations. One candidate after attributable critical-path opportunity and recoverable-time estimate. Failed qualification, unstable controls, unresolved instrumentation perturbation, or any failed safeguard prevents promotion. Correct interference before a new fully retained cohort; never lower thresholds.
latencyCampaign.admission: Policy frozen before measurement; executable campaign admission and all physical checks must pass before any superiority claim. Existing single-case analyzers cannot admit this multi-case campaign.
